title: Fix pytest OIDC source-scan after GitHubDeployStack helper refactor
description:
**Found by acceptance on #189 after merge.**

`python/tests/test_thinturn_deploy_script.py::test_github_deploy_stack_trusts_thinturn_development_workflow` still expects the inline OIDC claim `"token.actions.githubusercontent.com:environment": "development"`. `github-deploy-stack.ts` now passes `githubEnvironment` into `createGithubDeployRole`. Infra synth tests already cover trust correctly.

Also add the new Auth/ThinTurn staging+production (and missing Auth development) deploy scripts to `DEPLOY_SCRIPT_STACKS` so `--exclusively` stays gated.

**Do not:** change OIDC product behavior; dispatch workflows; cdk deploy.

**Done when:** pytest green on develop for this file; PR merged to develop.
